Name: PLAYER_MATERIAL_PRESET_PARAM_ST
Description:
Defines the Material options for Armored Cores.

Row ID links the Preset to the icon texture in SB_Material.dds and SB_Material.layout

Row ID + 210900 links the Preset to the FMG name it uses in the menu.

Fields.Name: Glow Level
Fields.Description: Light intensity of the material. Set it to 1 even on gloss-only presets, otherwise the material renders completely black.

Fields.Name: Layer 1 Material
Fields.Description: 6-digit texture ID (AEGXXX_YYY) for material layer 1 (base metal and similar).

Fields.Name: Layer 2 Material
Fields.Description: 6-digit texture ID (AEGXXX_YYY) for material layer 2 (base paint).

Fields.Name: Layer 3 Material
Fields.Description: 6-digit texture ID (AEGXXX_YYY) for material layer 3 (state after the base paint is applied).

Fields.Name: Albedo Texture
Fields.Description: Reference texture ID used to swap the material for each colouring.

Fields.Name: Normal/Shininess Texture
Fields.Description: Reference texture ID used to swap the material for each colouring.
